name: AppLaunchpad
summary: App store screenshot generator with 1000+ templates, device frames and export sizes for the App Store and Google Play.
description: A browser tool that turns raw app screens into store-ready screenshots. It provides 1000+ templates, device frames for the latest iPhone, iPad, Android phones and tablets, 2K+ icons and SVG graphics, illustrations, background and font styling, localization, and automatic scaling to the sizes Apple and Google require.
contains: 10K assets, fonts and graphics; 2K+ icons and SVGs
device frames for the latest iPhone, iPad and Android devices
auto-scaling to App Store and Google Play sizes
backgrounds, gradients, patterns, localization and font styling
